items.a: WOS is a Healthcare Hospitality platform connecting hospitals, hotels, and transport in one system for cross-border Thailand–Laos patients.

items.q: Are there extra fees for booking through WOS?
items.a: There are no extra fees for booking through WOS — prices shown come directly from our partners.

items.q: How do I book through WOS?
items.a: Choose a category, pick a program, and fill in the booking form on the website. Our team will contact you to confirm.

items.q: What if I need a hotel or transport?
items.a: You can request a hotel and transport during booking — our team handles it all in one invoice.

items.q: How can I reach the team?
items.a: You can reach us via Line or WhatsApp throughout your trip, as listed on our contact page.
